_meta.purpose: Curated business descriptions for EDS objects. Consumed by src/introspect.js (injects into per-table pages), src/generate-guide.js (curated guide), and src/generate-ms-description-sql.js (extended properties).
_meta.format: Three key shapes: (1) `<db>.<schema>.<object>` for tables, views, procedures, or functions; (2) `<db>.<schema>.<object>.<column>` for columns on tables/views; (3) cross-DB keys allowed in any shape. Each value is a 1-3 sentence description in plain English. 3-segment keys are resolved against tables/views first, then against procedures/functions; ambiguous names (a table and a routine sharing schema.name) are not supported.
_meta.scope: Curated set of the most load-bearing tables, views, and routines in the EDS production catalog. Add entries as needed; missing entries simply skip injection.
_meta.validation: Run `npm run descriptions:check` before regenerating — every key must reference a real DB / schema / object / column / routine.

EDS.dbo.Requisitions: Header record for every purchase request created in EDS. One row per requisition; line items live in `Detail`. Drives the approval workflow that ultimately produces a PO. Belongs to a District and originating User.
EDS.dbo.Detail: Line items for both requisitions and purchase orders — ~30M rows, the largest transactional table in the procurement chain. Each row links back to its `Requisitions` (and after conversion, to its `PO`) and references either a vendor catalog item via `CrossRefs` or a free-text entry. Pricing, quantities, and account distribution all live here.
EDS.dbo.Approvals: Per-step approval audit trail (~8M rows). Records who approved or rejected each requisition at each level of the district's approval chain, with timestamp and any comment. Combined with `PendingApprovals` to drive the queue an approver sees in the UI.
EDS.dbo.PendingApprovals: Active work queue — one row per (requisition, approver) pair currently awaiting action. Rows are deleted as approvers act; historical record is preserved in `Approvals`.
EDS.dbo.PO: Purchase order header (~2.5M rows). Created when a requisition reaches final approval and is converted. One PO has many `PODetailItems` lines and references the originating `Requisitions` row 1:1.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems: PO line-item detail (~24.5M rows). Snapshot of item, quantity, unit price, and account split at the moment of PO issuance. Independent from `Detail` — Detail can change after PO issuance, PODetailItems is the immutable contractual record.
EDS.dbo.POStatus: Lookup table of PO lifecycle states (open, partial, received, closed, voided, etc.) joined to `PO` via status code.
EDS.dbo.RequisitionChangeLog: Append-only audit log of edits to requisition headers and lines (~1.9M rows). Captures field-level before/after values with user and timestamp. Used for the requisition history view.
EDS.dbo.DetailChangeLog: Append-only audit log of edits to `Detail` rows (~2.9M rows). Same structure as `RequisitionChangeLog` but scoped to line items.
EDS.dbo.Vendors: Master vendor record — supplier directory for the whole platform (~19K rows). One row per vendor company. The `Active` column (tinyint) gates whether a vendor's catalogs and bid responses are visible to buyers; mutating it has system-wide effect.
EDS.dbo.VendorContacts: Named contacts (sales reps, AP contacts, etc.) attached to a vendor. Used for PO routing, bid notifications, and dispute correspondence.
EDS.dbo.VendorUploads: Log of every vendor catalog or pricing file submitted (~1.5M rows). Tracks file name, vendor, upload type, status, and the eventual import result. Direct writes to `CrossRefs` should always trace back to a row here.
EDS.dbo.Catalog: Vendor-published catalog — a named container that groups a set of `CrossRefs` entries (~4K rows). One vendor may publish multiple catalogs (e.g., per product line or per bid award).
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs: Vendor-item cross-reference (~171M rows — by far the hottest table in EDS). Maps a vendor's part number to an EDS `Items` master record with vendor-specific price, pack size, and effective dates. This is where pricing actually lives. Always filter or `TOP n` when querying — full scans are catastrophic.
EDS.dbo.Items: Master product catalog (~44M rows) — normalized, vendor-agnostic items that vendor offerings link to via `CrossRefs`. Categorized by `Category` and (where applicable) attributed to a `Manufacturers` record.
EDS.dbo.Category: Top-level product taxonomy (~134 rows). Small, stable lookup — used for browse, reporting rollups, and price-plan scoping.
EDS.dbo.Manufacturers: Manufacturer/brand directory (~9K rows). Note the legacy column spelling `Manufacturor` appears in some related tables — see quirks reference. Items reference a manufacturer; vendors do not.
EDS.dbo.BidHeaders: Bid solicitation header (~9.6K rows). One row per RFP/IFB/cooperative bid issued to vendors. Drives the bid-response window and ultimately produces `Awards`.
EDS.dbo.BidHeaderDetail: Per-line bid specifications (~123M rows — second-largest table in EDS). Holds the items, specs, and quantities a bid is asking vendors to price. Always filter by `BidHeaderId` before any analytical work.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestItems: Items the bid is asking about (~27.9M rows) — paired with `BidHeaderDetail` to define the buy. Vendor responses to these line items land in `BidResults`.
EDS.dbo.BidItems: Master list of items eligible to appear on bids (~27.5M rows). Distinct from `BidRequestItems` (request-time snapshot) — this is the catalog side.
EDS.dbo.Bids: Vendor bid response header (~147K rows). One row per (bid, vendor) submission, indicating intent to respond and submission status. Line-by-line responses are in `BidResults`.
EDS.dbo.BidResults: Vendor line-item bid responses (~33.2M rows) — the prices, lead times, and notes a vendor submitted for each `BidRequestItems` line they chose to bid on.
EDS.dbo.Awards: Bid award outcomes (~139K rows). Records which vendor's `BidResults` were chosen for each awarded line, including award date and award type. Awarded prices typically flow back into `CrossRefs` via a vendor catalog upload.
EDS.dbo.BidAnswers: Vendor responses to non-pricing bid questions (~552K rows) — terms, certifications, attribute confirmations.
EDS.dbo.District: Master record for a participating school district or other public entity (~979 rows). Top of the customer hierarchy. Budgets, approval chains, and price plans attach here. Treat as effectively static — bulk changes propagate everywhere.
EDS.dbo.School: Schools/buildings beneath a district (~6.6K rows). Used for ship-to address and reporting rollups; not a security boundary.
EDS.dbo.Users: Master user directory (~345K rows) — every person with login or named-recipient status across all districts. `Active` flag controls login eligibility; deletion is rare (audit references).
EDS.dbo.UserAccounts: Per-user budget account permissions (~3.4M rows). Joins users to the `BudgetAccounts` they're allowed to charge against. Drives the account dropdown shown when building a requisition.
EDS.dbo.BudgetAccounts: District budget accounts / charge codes (~1.4M rows). Hierarchical (often fund-function-object), district-scoped. Requisition lines distribute against rows here.
EDS.dbo.PricePlans: Named price-plan definitions (~585 rows) — controls which categories/vendors are visible to which districts at what pricing tier. Small but pivotal: changes here change what buyers see.
EDS.dbo.Audit: Generic audit log (~2.6M rows) — application-level events (logins, permission changes, data exports, admin actions). Distinct from the change-log tables, which are field-level.
EDS.dbo.TransactionLog_HISTORY: Long-tail historical event log (~124M rows). Cold storage — query with date filters and expect slow reads. Rarely needed for operational work; kept for compliance.
EDS.dbo.OrderBookDetail: Aggregated order/spending facts used by reporting (~37.8M rows). Fed from completed `PODetailItems`. The `OrderBookDetailOld` table (~187M rows) is the prior-format archive — read but do not write.
EDS.dbo.OrderBookDetailOld: Legacy archive of `OrderBookDetail` (~187M rows). Read-only; all new spend rolls up into `OrderBookDetail`.
EDS.dbo.ReportSession: User-facing report executions (~5.4M rows) — what reports were run, by whom, with which parameters.
EDS.dbo.ReportSessionLinks: Per-session output links (~52.7M rows) — joins a report session to the rows it generated, used to support drill-throughs and saved exports.
EDS.dbo.BatchDetail: Staging table for batch-imported requisition / order detail (~5M rows). Holds raw character-typed values (`OrigType`, `OrigDistrictCode`, `OrigCometCode`, `OrigItemCode`, `OrigQuantity`) alongside their resolved IDs so the importer can report and back-out errors. `ErrorField` flags malformed rows.
EDS.dbo.BidProductLinePrices: Manufacturer product-line discount tiers offered by a vendor on a bid (~1.3M rows). `RangeBase` is the dollar floor for the tier; `DiscountRate` is the percent off list. Joins a `BidProductLines` row to its tiered pricing structure.
EDS.dbo.BidMappedItems: Audit of item remapping decisions made during bid setup. Records the original `OrigItemId`, the chosen `NewItemId`, a `ReasonCode`, and the date — so award lineage stays explicit when a bid line is re-pointed at a different master item.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestPriceRanges: Quantity / dollar tier definitions a bid is asking vendors to price against (~1.9M rows). Tied to a `BidHeaderId` and (optionally) a manufacturer/product-line, with a `RangeBase` floor and `RangeWeight` used to compute the weighted bid score.
EDS.dbo.BidAnswersJournal: Append-only change history for `BidAnswers` (~1.3M rows). Captures the prior value, session, and modification timestamp every time a vendor edits a non-pricing bid response.
EDS.dbo.BidMSRPResultPrices: Per-tier MSRP-discount results submitted by a vendor on an MSRP-style bid (~423K rows). One row per `BidRequestPriceRange` per vendor result, with the discount-applied price.
EDS.dbo.BidRequestOptions: Optional bid-line attributes per (manufacturer, product line) — color, capacity, etc. Each row weights one named option for use in vendor evaluation.
EDS.dbo.EmailBlastLog: Audit of every transactional / marketing email sent from the platform (~1.5M rows). Captures sender, recipient, CC/BCC, send date, and the rendered XML payload. `Attachment` is the file name, not the content.
EDS.dbo.ImportDetail: Raw rows captured from a generic file import (~883K rows). One row of `ImportData` per source line, scoped to an `ImportId` header. Read after parsing to inspect malformed input.
EDS.dbo.IPQueueUsers: Per-user import-process queue assignments (~490K rows). Tracks `Requested`, `Started`, `Completed` timestamps and `Status` so background work can be parallelized and resumed.
EDS.dbo.POQueueItems: Outbound PO transmission queue (~401K rows). One row per PO send attempt, with `SendStarted`, `SendEnded`, `SendStatus` and a `PayloadId` referencing the rendered cXML / email body.
EDS.dbo.PricingConsolidatedOrderCounts: Demand-history counts feeding the consolidated-pricing analytics pipeline (~401K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ItemId`) with `OrderCount` — used to weight bid evaluation by realized buying patterns.
EDS.dbo.RTK_ReportItems: New Jersey Right-To-Know chemical-reporting line items (~1M rows). Joins district + site + category + item + quantity, paired with `RTK_Sites` (locations) and `RTK_Items` (chemical detail). Feeds the annual NJ RTK survey.
EDS.dbo.DetailNotifications: Buyer-facing notifications about line-item changes (~3M rows). When a vendor substitutes or replaces an item the system writes a row here capturing the original vs. new `ItemId`, `VendorId`, and `BidPrice` so the buyer can review.
EDS.dbo.TaskSchedule: Bid-cycle / pricing-cycle work schedule (~1.5M rows). Tracks original, projected, and actual start/end dates for each task in a project, scoped by district, category, and price plan.
EDS.dbo.SessionTable: Active and recent user-session state (~12.8M rows). Holds the user's current district, school, requisition, PO, budget, mode, and screen state. Hot during business hours; queried heavily on every page load.
EDS.dbo.DMSVendorBidDocuments: Document metadata for vendor bid attachments stored in the document-management system (~750K rows). One row per uploaded file with `DocType`, `ExpirationDate`, page count, and a `DocId` GUID pointing into DMS storage.
EDS.dbo.CatalogTextParts: Tokenized catalog text for full-text search (~17M rows). One row per text fragment per `CatalogText` entry with a `BaseOffset` so the original text can be reassembled. Rebuilt during catalog imports.
EDS.dbo.HeaderWorkItems: Working set of items being aggregated into an OrderBook header (~492K rows). Transient — populated during OrderBook generation and emptied when the run completes.
EDS.dbo.DetailChanges: Quantity-change log on `Detail` lines (~26.5M rows). One row per qty edit capturing `OrigQty` / `NewQty` with `ChangeDate`, plus the surrounding `RequisitionId`, `ItemId`, `BidItemId`, `BidPrice` snapshot. Coarser-grained than `DetailChangeLog` (which is field-level across all columns) — this table tracks only quantity transitions.
EDS.dbo.BidResultChanges: Append-only edit log on `BidResults` (~18.2M rows). Records before/after `Active`, `UnitPrice`, `BidType`, and `Comments` whenever a vendor's bid response is modified. Pairs with `BidResultsChangeLog` which adds the user / reason context.
EDS.dbo.BidResultsChangeLog: User-attributed reason log for `BidResults` edits (~242K rows). One row per change action with `UserId`, `SessionId`, free-text `Reason`, and the surrounding requisition / detail / item / price context. Read alongside `BidResultChanges` for the full audit picture.
EDS.dbo.allitems: Denormalized flat snapshot joining `BidHeaders` × `Items` × `CrossRefs` × `Catalog` × `PricePlans` × `Category` (~6.3M rows). Reporting / working table — pricing, descriptions, vendor item codes, and order-vs-bid totals collapsed into one wide row. Rebuilt by batch jobs; not a system of record.
EDS.dbo.DebugMsgs: Generic application debug log (~23.7M rows) — one row per `Msg` with `LogDate`. Purely diagnostic; safe to truncate. The `_Orig` variant is an earlier rollover.
EDS.dbo.TransactionLogCF: Outbound HTTP request/response log for integration calls (~3.5M rows). Captures `URL`, `Method`, `Headers`, `Content`, request-start/end timestamps, target server, and session. Used to debug cXML / vendor-API integrations. Rolls over into `TransactionLogCF_Arc`.
EDS.dbo.TransactionLogCF_Arc: Archived rollover of `TransactionLogCF` (~31.6M rows). Same shape; cold storage for older integration request logs.
EDS.dbo.SecurityRoleUsers: User-to-security-role junction (~365K rows). Drives application-level permission checks — every effective role a user holds is one row here.
EDS.dbo.DistrictVendor: Per-district vendor enablement (~317K rows). FK to both `District` and `Vendors`; the `Active` flag scopes a vendor's visibility to a specific district, and `VendorsAccountCode` stores the district's internal account code with that vendor (used on POs).
EDS.dbo.DistrictCategories: Per-district overrides on the global `Category` taxonomy (~126K rows). Controls visibility (`Active`), surcharges (`Charge`), permission flags for addenda / incidentals / budget books / order books, RTK location, and display `Priority`. Treat as district-level configuration of the catalog browse experience.
EDS.dbo.Headings: Sub-category browse-tree headings under each `Category` (~306K rows). Can be district-scoped via `DistrictId`; `ExpandAll` controls default UI expansion. Drives the catalog browse hierarchy buyers see when shopping.
EDS.dbo.BidManufacturers: Bid-level manufacturer participation (~253K rows). One row per (`BidId`, `ManufacturerId`) with the negotiated `DiscountRate`. Aliased `BMA` elsewhere — referenced by `BidProductLines.BMAId`.
EDS.dbo.BidProductLines: Finer-grained discounts under a `BidManufacturers` row (~288K rows). Per-product-line (and per-`MSRPOptionId`) discount rate within the manufacturer's bid participation. Resolves the actual rate to apply when an item maps to a specific product line.
EDS.dbo.PriceRanges: Tiered MSRP / list-price brackets per (`CategoryId`, `ManufacturerId`, `ManufacturerProductLineId`) (~120K rows). `RangeBase` and `RangeWeight` parameterize price-based scoring used during bid evaluation and MSRP normalization.
EDS.dbo.PricingAddenda: Denormalized item-pricing snapshot used to render pricing addenda (~210K rows). Flattens `CrossRefs` + `Catalog` + `Heading` + `Keyword` + `Vendor` + `District` + `Award` into a wide row including catalog / list / last-bid prices, full description, and indexed text fields. Rebuilt by addendum jobs.
EDS.dbo.SafetyDataSheets: Master URL list of vendor SDS documents (~158K rows). Each row is a unique `SDSURL` with created / updated / deleted timestamps. Linked physical document blobs live in `SDSDocs`.
EDS.dbo.SDSDocs: Stored SDS document blobs (~161K rows). One PDF per row keyed to `ItemId` (and optionally `CrossRefId` / legacy `MSDSId`), with `OrigURL`, `Checksum` for dedup, and a varbinary(max) `Document`. The current SDS storage path; legacy MSDS data lives in `MSDS` / `MSDSDetail`.
EDS.dbo.MSDSDetail: Chemical-composition lines on a legacy MSDS sheet (~138K rows). Junction of `MSDS` to `RTK_CASFile` with `MixturePercent`. FK CASCADE on parent `MSDS`. Superseded for current ingestion by the SDS pipeline (`SafetyDataSheets` / `SDSDocs`) but still queried for historical sheets.
EDS.dbo.RTK_MSDSDetail: Right-To-Know variant of `MSDSDetail` keyed to `RTK_Items` instead of `MSDS` (~152K rows). Feeds the NJ RTK reporting flow alongside `RTK_ReportItems` and `RTK_CASFile`.
EDS.dbo.Images: Master image-asset record (~1.7M rows). Holds source URL, local paths (full / resized / thumbnail), perceptual hash (`pHash`, `bipHash`) for dedup, format / dimensions, and a `dateDeleted` soft-delete column. The single source of truth for product imagery referenced by catalog UI.
EDS.dbo.ImageLog: Image-fetch audit log (~1.8M rows). One row per HTTP fetch attempt with `statusCode`, `statusText`, `contentType`, response headers, and write outcome. Used to diagnose broken / stale image URLs sourced from vendor catalogs.
EDS.dbo.OrderBookLog: Print / render log for OrderBooks (~474K rows). Captures who printed which `OrderBookId` (district / school / user), how many items and pages were emitted, and the target `Device`. Operational telemetry, not a financial record.
EDS.dbo.SSOLoginTracking: SSO login event audit (~188K rows). One row per attempted SSO `Action` per (`SSOProvider`, `Email`) with `ErrorMsg` / `Description` payloads. Used to debug SAML / OAuth login failures.
EDS.dbo.ResetPasswordTracking: Password-reset email audit (~125K rows). One row per reset request with the issued `ResetPasswordCode`, target email, district / school context, and action / error payload. Indexed on `ResetPasswordCode` for verification.
EDS.VMS.vw_Login: Vendor-portal login lookup view. Used by the vendor-management UI to authenticate and resolve a vendor's accessible bids.
EDS.VMS.vw_BidsByVendor: Vendor-portal view listing bids visible to each vendor — the per-vendor cut of `BidHeaders` joined with award status. Drives the vendor's bid-list screen.
EDS.EDSIQWebUser.OrderBookView: Reporting view over consolidated order data — top-level grain, suitable for dashboard summaries.
EDS.EDSIQWebUser.OrderBookDetailView: Reporting view exposing line-level OrderBook detail — the drill-through target from `OrderBookView`.
EDS.EDSIQWebUser.POAccountList: Reporting view listing PO line items by budget account — used for budget-utilization reports.
Catalogs.dbo.Master Catalog: Consolidated cross-vendor master catalog used as the import target for catalog file processing (~144M rows — the largest table on the server). Read-heavy; rebuilt by the catalog-import pipeline.
Catalogs.dbo.CatalogImports: Catalog-import job audit (~405 rows) — one row per upload run, capturing source, status, and outcome counts.
Catalogs.dbo.uniqueCodes: Dedup helper for catalog imports (~331K rows) — tracks unique vendor part / item codes already seen so subsequent runs can skip duplicates.
Catalogs.dbo.Grainger Jan 2019: Frozen snapshot of the Grainger January 2019 catalog feed (~1.5M rows). One of several Grainger snapshots in this DB (`Grainger Jan 2015`, `…Jan 2016`, `…Jan 2017`, `…Jan 2017 Revised`, `…Feb 2018`, `…May 2018`, `…May 2017`, `…May 2016`). Kept for historical pricing comparisons.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.Entities: Customer entities (districts and other public organizations) participating in cooperative procurement — analytics-side master record. Distinct from `EDS.dbo.District` and includes additional analytics fields like `StudentCount`, `Population`, `Region`.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.Vendors: Analytics-side vendor master. Smaller and cleaner than `EDS.dbo.Vendors` — kept in sync via the analytics ETL.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.Contracts: Cooperative-contract master used for spend analytics. Captures contract value, term, negotiated savings, status, and auto-renew settings per (vendor, contract).
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.PurchaseOrders: PO header — analytics flatten of EDS PO data with denormalized department / cost-center / project-code fields and lifecycle dates.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.PurchaseOrderLi: PO line detail joined back to its `PurchaseOrders` header. Holds qty, unit price, line total, UoM, and received qty for variance analysis.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.SpendTransactio: Atomic spend events feeding the analytics fact tables. Each row pairs a PO line with a contract (or `IsOffContract = 1` for maverick spend) plus fiscal-period attributes.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.EntitySpend: Bridge linking an `Entity` to a `SpendTransaction` so spend can be rolled up by entity without re-traversing the PO chain.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.VendorPerforman: Periodic vendor scorecards — on-time-delivery percent, quality, defect rate, responsiveness, cost competitiveness, and overall score. Drives vendor ranking and renewal recommendations.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.EntityVendors: Many-to-many of which vendors each entity transacts with, including the relationship start date and a primary-vendor flag.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.EntityBudgets: Per-entity, per-fiscal-year budget allocations by category. `AllocatedAmount` is the original amount; `AmendedAmount` reflects mid-year revisions.
ProcurementAnalytics.dbo.BudgetAllocatio: Org-level budget allocations (department / cost center / project / category) used as the rollup target for entity-level spend analytics.
EDS.dbo.Vendors.Active: Tinyint flag (0/1) controlling whether the vendor is visible across the platform. Setting to 0 hides the vendor's catalogs and bid responses everywhere — system-wide effect, not a soft delete.
EDS.dbo.Vendors.Code: Short alphanumeric vendor code (≤16 chars) used as a human-friendly identifier on POs and reports. Distinct from `VendorId` (the surrogate key).
EDS.dbo.Vendors.DistrictId: When non-null, marks this vendor as district-specific (only visible to that district). When null, the vendor is platform-wide.
EDS.dbo.Vendors.UseGrossPrices: Tinyint flag (0/1). If 1, this vendor's pricing is interpreted as gross (list) prices that must be discounted against bid terms. If 0, prices are net.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.Active: Tinyint flag (0/1) controlling whether this cross-ref appears in catalog browse / search results. The 1 → 0 transition is the normal soft-deactivate path; rows are rarely physically deleted.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.CatalogPrice: Vendor's catalog (list) price for this item, in dollars. The price actually charged to a buyer is computed by applying the bid/award discount on top of this value — see `GrossPrice`.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.GrossPrice: Pre-discount price used when the parent vendor has `UseGrossPrices = 1`. The discounted price = `GrossPrice * (1 - discountRate)`.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.Manufacturor: Manufacturer name as text (note the legacy typo: `Manufacturor`, not `Manufacturer`). Use the normalized `ManufacturerId` FK instead for joins; this column is kept for historical / legacy display.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.DoNotDiscount: Boolean-as-int flag. Non-zero means the system must NOT apply bid discounts to this cross-ref — used for special-deal items priced at net.
EDS.dbo.CrossRefs.DateDeactivated: Set when `Active` flips to 0. NULL for currently-active cross-refs.
EDS.dbo.Detail.DetailId: Surrogate primary key. Stable across the requisition → PO conversion; line items keep the same `DetailId` once they migrate from req-only to PO-attached.
EDS.dbo.Detail.RequisitionId: FK to `Requisitions`. Always set — every line item belongs to a requisition. Combined with `RequisitionId`-based filtering for any per-req query.
EDS.dbo.Detail.POId: FK to `PO`. NULL while the line is still on an unconverted requisition; set when the requisition reaches final approval and converts to a purchase order. Use `WHERE POId IS NULL` to find req-only lines.
EDS.dbo.Detail.ItemId: FK to `Items` (the master product). NULL for free-text / off-catalog lines. When set, prefer joining via `CrossRefId` to get vendor-specific pricing.
EDS.dbo.Detail.CrossRefId: FK to `CrossRefs` — the specific vendor-priced row this line was built from. Captures the vendor and price at requisition time. NULL for free-text lines.
EDS.dbo.Detail.VendorId: FK to `Vendors`. The vendor this line is being purchased from — denormalized from `CrossRefs` for performance.
EDS.dbo.Detail.BidHeaderId: FK to `BidHeaders` — which bid award this price came from. Important for spend-by-bid reporting and for verifying that the captured price still reflects an active award.
EDS.dbo.Detail.BidPrice: Per-unit price at requisition time, in dollars. The frozen price the requisition is being approved against; line total = `BidPrice * Quantity`. Independent of the live `CrossRefs.CatalogPrice` (which can change).
EDS.dbo.Detail.Quantity: Units ordered. Integer; fractional quantities are not supported on this table. Combined with `BidPrice` to compute line total.
EDS.dbo.Detail.Active: Tinyint flag (0/1). 0 marks a line as soft-deleted / cancelled; rows are rarely physically removed because of audit references in `DetailChangeLog`.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.PODetailItemId: Surrogate primary key for the immutable PO line snapshot. Distinct from `DetailId` — one `Detail` row produces exactly one `PODetailItems` row at conversion.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.POId: FK to `PO`. Always set — every PO line item belongs to a purchase order.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.DetailId: Back-link to the originating `Detail` row. Lets you trace from a PO line back to the requisition history.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.ItemId: FK to `Items`. Frozen at PO issuance — does NOT update if the master `Items` row changes later.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.VendorId: FK to `Vendors`. The vendor this PO line ships from — frozen at PO issuance.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.BidPrice: Per-unit price locked in at PO issuance, in dollars. Contractual — does not change even if the source bid is later re-awarded or `Detail.BidPrice` is edited.
EDS.dbo.PODetailItems.Quantity: Units ordered, locked in at PO issuance. For receiving variance, compare against the receiving-side tables, not against `Detail.Quantity`.
